rationale: P characterises braking behaviour itself, which must be evaluated to address SG-3's prevention of unintended braking. Its declared operational scope and sudden-stopping event are grounded in H-3, while FR-7 supplies the intended collision-avoidance braking context. P does not expand into sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing. Sudden stopping is part of the hazardous behaviour, not an imported timing constraint.
determining_elements: The vehicle's braking behaviour and whether braking occurs as intended or unexpectedly directly address the evaluation target.
Straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h in good weather, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, matches H-3's operational situation.
The scoped event of sudden stopping while driving is explicitly established by H-3.
Collision-avoidance braking is supported by FR-7 as the intended behavioural context; its supporting detection and control mechanisms are not incorporated into P.
